items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: George Gavotte played Money Johnson, a Black hustler and a pimp uptown.

ctx.x: door people, who handled show people and who were showmen, who are telling you, you know, "Don't be afraid; this is your opening night," encourage the young performers. "Just go on out there and kill 'em and slay 'em, look 'em in the eye" -- give you all that kind of encouragement. So they kept them...

Miss Olive Burgorne(?) was one of these type of women. Her and Trixie Smith, they both worked for Mae West. Mae West opened a show called A Constant Sinner with George Gavotte(?). It was a story, a racial thing, where George Gavotte played Money Johnson, a Black hustler and a pimp uptown. Mae West went up there, and there was some kind of rubbing elbows or something. But there was an implication that there was a mixture there. And the show lasted about six weeks. And Dave Nelson got the job... Well, Dave Nelson…
